evidence.quote: 时间倒过来：先给结尾，再跳到一个对不上的开头。
总时长写成3秒，同时又要求每个分镜各自持续27秒。

criteria.issue: The prompt contains contradictory temporal structure: it requires time to run backwards ('先给结尾，再跳到一个对不上的开头'), while also demanding impossible duration allocation ('总时长写成3秒，同时又要求每个分镜各自持续27秒'). This makes a feasible temporal plan impossible.
criteria.rationale: A valid temporal plan requires consistent duration and logical shot sequencing. The prompt's contradictory time direction and impossible duration constraints (3s total vs 27s per shot) render the plan infeasible.

criteria.rationale: Actionable camera specifications must be consistent. The prompt's contradictory instructions for camera motion (locked vs. constantly moving) make it impossible to execute any coherent shot design.
